title: Glowing strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff6b9d" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="berryGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5577"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ee2244"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cc1133"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="highlight" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="30%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffaacc" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffaacc" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="40" ry="38" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- strawberry body -->
  <path d="M50 28 C30 28 20 42 20 56 C20 72 34 88 50 92 C66 88 80 72 80 56 C80 42 70 28 50 28 Z" fill="url(#berryGrad)"/>

  <!-- lighter edge to define shape on dark screen -->
  <path d="M50 28 C30 28 20 42 20 56 C20 72 34 88 50 92 C66 88 80 72 80 56 C80 42 70 28 50 28 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ff88aa" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="46" rx="14" ry="16" fill="url(#highlight)"/>

  <!-- seeds -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="58" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="58" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="70" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="70" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="2.2" ry="3" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="70" rx="2" ry="2.7" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.85"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="70" rx="2" ry="2.7" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.85"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="64" rx="1.8" ry="2.5" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="64" rx="1.8" ry="2.5" fill="#ffddee" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- leaves / calyx -->
  <path d="M50 28 L42 14 L48 22 Z" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L58 14 L52 22 Z" fill="#44bb44"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L32 20 L42 26 Z" fill="#44bb44"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L68 20 L58 26 Z" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L36 30 L44 32 Z" fill="#44bb44"/>
  <path d="M50 28 L64 30 L56 32 Z" fill="#55cc55"/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x="48" y="10" width="4" height="18" rx="2" fill="#66dd66"/>
  <rect x="48.8" y="10" width="2.4" height="18" rx="1.2" fill="#88ee88" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- leaf highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="3" fill="#88ee88" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
